board: YC Jobs / Work at a Startup
extract_js: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/companies/"][href*="/jobs/"]')).map(a => ({ href: new URL(a.getAttribute('href'), location.origin).href, title: (a.textContent || '').trim() })).filter(x => x.title && x.href).reduce((acc, x) => { if (!acc.find(y => y.href === x.href)) acc.push(x); return acc; }, []).slice(0, 30)
rules: Use the public ycombinator.com job pages first; they expose stable company job links without login
Filter by role, location, experience, and employment type only after opening the full listing
Many individual listings omit posting dates; exclude them when the prompt has a posting-age gate and no current card or listing provides verifiable age
Use workatastartup.com only as fallback because its search page may return no fetchable body
notes: Public routes verified: base jobs, software engineer, India, and remote software engineer
Discovery exposed at least 15 stable listing links
